name: plc-learning-simulator

scripts.format: prettier --write src desktop/*.cjs electron-builder.yml index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json README.md DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md docs/ENGINE_RULES.md
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:desktop: npm run typecheck && vite build --outDir desktop-staging
scripts.package:mac:intel: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --mac dir --x64 --publish never

description: PLC零基础实验教学与离线仿真桌面应用
author: PLC Learning Simulator contributors
